test_game_controller_look_at_2d: test the GameController.look_at_2d method to rotate the player towards a target angle in the horizontal plane
test_game_controller_move_to: test the GameController.move_to method to move the player to specific x, y coordinates with optional max_speed
test_game_controller_stop: test the GameController.stop method to halt player movement and verify it stops within a bounded number of steps
test_game_controller_exceptions: test that GameController raises PathBlockedError when the path is blocked and EpisodeFinishedError when the episode ends
test_game_controller_rotate: test the GameController.rotate method to rotate the player by a delta angle with adaptive speed and tolerance
